description: Generic template for local MCP communication intake. Copy to an ignored mcp.local*.json file or user-scope client config before adding private values.

antigravity.notes: Prefer runtime-provided read-only MCP/connector capabilities. Do not store private tenant, client, or allowlist values in tracked repo files.

codex.notes: Prefer available app connectors or MCP tools surfaced by the runtime. Keep durable output in ignored repo folders.

example_commands: claude mcp add -s user --transport http --client-id '<slack-client-id>' --callback-port '<port>' slack '<slack-mcp-url>'
claude_code.notes: Use placeholders here only. Actual command arguments come from approved internal setup docs and must remain local.

ms365.purpose: Read-only Outlook mail, Calendar, Teams, meeting transcripts, Planner, Todo, contacts, and people capabilities when explicitly scoped.

slack.purpose: Read-only Slack channel, message, thread, user, and canvas context when explicitly scoped.
